fileformat.struct:
16 bytes. The variables a motiongraph can branch on.
NOT an enumnamer, although the loader used to say "probably same layout". Both formats open with a uint64 count, so that guess read the count correctly by luck and the body entirely wrong, then wrote a ZStringList where a pointer array belongs. Measured before this: 9 of 70 files round-tripped, and those 9 were exactly the 9 EMPTY ones - every file actually declaring a variable lost a block and two fragments.

48 bytes
`kind` selects how the variable is driven: 0 = bool, 2 = trigger, 3 = enum. For an enum, `enum_name` names the .enumnamer holding the member names - and it targets the SAME string as `var_name`, so the file is a DAG rather than a tree and needs pointer aliasing to round-trip without writing the string twice.
